review:
Wild Tiger 2 is the sequel to one of BGaming's most popular games, redesigning the tiger as a kung fu hero and adding a Hold and Win feature. It plays on 40 lines.

The Hold and Win round starts with three respins and only sticky coins can land. At the start, three multipliers are generated (2x–5x, 10x or 15x) and placed in empty cells; any coin that later lands on one of those cells has its value multiplied. Each new coin resets the respins, and the round ends when the grid fills or the respins run out. BGaming keeps the series' medium-low volatility rating while raising the maximum to 5,000x, and the RTP is 97%. A nice balance of steady play and a meaningful bonus.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
